scripts.setup: npm --prefix web install && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q uv workers-py==1.17.9
scripts.dev: npm run build && PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pywrangler dev
scripts.dev:scripted: npm run build && PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pywrangler dev --env scripted
scripts.deploy: npm run build && PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pywrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:ci: pip install -q uv workers-py==1.17.9 && pywrangler deploy
